core_capabilities.core.code_understanding: Read and reason about existing code across files.
core_capabilities.core.code_generation: Write new code that follows existing conventions.
core_capabilities.core.code_review: Critically review a diff for correctness, security and scope.
core_capabilities.core.reasoning: Multi-step reasoning about designs, bugs and trade-offs.
core_capabilities.core.tool_use: Call tools reliably and act on their results.
core_capabilities.core.shell: Run shell commands in the project environment.
core_capabilities.core.filesystem: Read and write files in the repository.
core_capabilities.core.structured_output: Emit output conforming to a JSON schema.
core_capabilities.core.long_context: Work accurately with very large inputs.
core_capabilities.core.summarization: Compress information without losing decisions or evidence.
core_capabilities.core.browsing: Fetch and read web content (always untrusted data).
core_capabilities.core.persistent_state: Retain state across sessions outside the repository.
core_capabilities.core.prompt_caching: Reuse a stable context prefix cheaply.
